manual.title: FUJIFILM DIGITAL CAMERA X-T200 Owner’s Manual

battery_chamber_cover_latch.name: Battery-chamber cover latch
battery_chamber_cover_latch.default_function: Slide to open the battery-chamber cover.

battery_latch.name: Battery latch
battery_latch.default_function: Press to the side to release the battery.

diopter_adjustment_control.name: Diopter adjustment control
diopter_adjustment_control.default_function: Rotate to bring the viewfinder display into sharp focus.

display_back_button.name: DISP (display)/BACK button
display_back_button.default_function: Change the display or go back.

drive_delete_button.name: Drive button / Delete button (playback mode)
drive_delete_button.default_function: Display drive mode options; delete pictures in playback mode.

fn1_button.name: Fn1 button
fn1_button.default_function: TOUCH MENU by default; its role can be assigned to another listed function.

fn2_button.name: Fn2 button
fn2_button.default_function: AE-LOCK by default; its role can be assigned to another listed function.

focus_stick.name: Focus stick (focus lever)
focus_stick.default_function: Tilt or press to select the focus area and navigate menus; its role can be chosen using FOCUS LEVER SETTING.

front_command_dial.name: Front command dial
front_command_dial.default_function: During shooting, choose a shutter speed and aperture combination (program shift), adjust aperture, or choose shutter speed; in menus, select tabs or pages; in the Q menu, adjust settings; in playback, view other pictures.

function_dial.name: Fn (function) dial
function_dial.default_function: DEFAULT role: filter selection in Adv.; scene selection in SP; self-timer in S (ADVANCED SR AUTO)/M/N/O; film simulation in P/S/A/M/u; shutter speed in F (MOVIE).

lcd_touchscreen.name: Vari-angle LCD monitor / Touch screen
lcd_touchscreen.default_function: The LCD monitor can be tilted or reversed and also functions as a touch screen. Touch controls can select the focus area or take photographs and open the touch menu. The default T.B. Fn1 and T.B. Fn2 roles are WHITE BALANCE and FILM SIMULATION.

lens_release_button.name: Lens release button
lens_release_button.default_function: Press to release the attached lens for removal.

menu_ok_button.name: MENU/OK button
menu_ok_button.default_function: Open menus and select or confirm menu items.

positions.label: icon
positions.description: Follow an on-screen guide to create a panorama.

on_off_button.name: ON/OFF button
on_off_button.default_function: Turn the camera on or off.

rear_command_dial.name: Rear command dial
rear_command_dial.default_function: During shooting, choose shutter speed or adjust exposure compensation; in menus, highlight items; in the Q menu, adjust settings; in playback, zoom in or out.

shutter_button.name: Shutter button
shutter_button.default_function: Half-press to focus and lock focus and exposure; press fully to take a picture. In F (MOVIE) mode, the shutter button can also be used for movie recording.

view_mode_button.name: VIEW MODE button
view_mode_button.default_function: Cycle the display modes for the electronic viewfinder and LCD monitor.
